input.content: {"project": "Alder payroll", "job_id": "worker-938d5df50306", "workspace": "/workspace", "platform_document": "/workspace/PLATFORM.md"}

Source documents: alder-payroll-04.csv and alder-payroll-terms-04.csv.

Provide a delivery summary when finished.
